title: The Crest
together: The day's tension reaches its confrontation. The canceled exhibition brings an older difference into the open: what each person understands emotional support to mean.
This chapter will connect their present reactions to their histories without settling those still-unwritten backstories in advance.
aarna: She needs him to understand that the work is personal, not simply something that needs a new buyer.
At the heart of what she wants to say is a request to be vulnerable beside him, rather than another demand to be strong.
mukund: He insists that he is trying to help. Finding a next step is the response he knows, but it is not the response she needs now.
He reaches the difficult admission that being willing to support her does not mean he already knows how to offer that support.
